entities.summary: Jenny Rosenthal Bramley was a Russian-born American physicist. She held numerous patents on electroluminescence and electro-optics, and was cited by the IEEE as being "well known for her innovative work in lasers." She was the second woman elected as a fellow of the IEEE.
